mapper.sql: i.id, i.instance_code, i.instance_name, i.owner_context, i.object_type, i.object_id, i.template_id, i.template_revision_id, i.template_revision_no, i.engine_code, i.designer_version, i.renderer_version, i.value_json, i.created_by, i.version, i.creator, i.create_time, i.updater, i.update_time, i.deleted, i.tenant_id, t.template_code AS template_code, t.template_name AS template_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_dynamic_form_instance (id, instance_code, instance_name, owner_context, object_type, object_id, template_id, template_revision_id, template_revision_no, engine_code, designer_version, renderer_version, value_json, created_by, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.instanceCode}, #{row.instanceName}, #{row.ownerContext}, #{row.objectType}, #{row.objectId}, #{row.templateId}, #{row.templateRevisionId}, #{row.templateRevisionNo}, #{row.engineCode}, #{row.designerVersion}, #{row.rendererVersion}, #{row.valueJson}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.version}, #{row.creator}, COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, NOW()), #{row.updater}, COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, NOW()), #{row.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plt_dynamic_form_instance i JOIN plt_dynamic_form_template t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND t.id = i.template_id AND t.deleted = b'0' WHERE i.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND i.id = #{query.instanceId} AND i.deleted = b'0'
SELECT i.* FROM plt_dynamic_form_instance i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND i.id = #{query.instanceId} AND i.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_dynamic_form_instance SET value_json = #{update.valueJson}, version = version + 1, updater = #{update.updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND id = #{update.instanceId} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
